# hpe_morpheus_security_group (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Security Group resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the security group.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the security group is active.
- `description` (String) The description of the security group.
- `zone_id` (Number) The cloud (zone) ID for the security group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the security group.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the security group.
